When recomputing summary statistics from an array that may contain malformed or non-record entries, we must preserve the raw count of all elements for the total count, but filter the array to record-only entries before performing property-based filtering or aggregation.

```javascript
function recomputeSummary(rows, pageTextIndexes, sideEffectReceipt) {
  const rawRows = asArray(rows);
  const recordRows = rawRows.filter(isRecord);
  const samePageRows = recordRows.filter((row) => row.page_exposure_risk?.page_contains_other_questions === true);
  const sourceDedupeKeys = new Set(recordRows.flatMap((row) => asArray(row.locator_candidates)
    .filter((candidate) => isRecord(candidate) && candidate.ambiguous !== true)
    .filter((candidate) => Number.isInteger(candidate.pdf_page_number_one_based))
    .map((candidate) => `${candidate.ms_document_id}:${candidate.source_pdf_sha256}:${candidate.pdf_page_number_one_based}`)));
  return {
    total_governed_rows: rawRows.length,
    unique_question_row_id_count: new Set(recordRows.map((row) => row.question_id).filter(Boolean)).size,
    locator_status_before_counts: countBy(recordRows, (row) => row.locator_status_before),
    locator_status_after_counts: countBy(recordRows, (row) => row.locator_status_after),
    backfilled_row_count: recordRows.filter((row) => row.locator_status_after === 'page_backfilled').length,
    existing_page_locator_preserved_row_count:
      recordRows.filter((row) => PAGE_LOCATED_BEFORE.has(row.locator_status_before)).length,
    document_only_row_count: recordRows.filter((row) => row.locator_status_after === 'document_only').length,
    ambiguous_row_count: recordRows.filter((row) => row.locator_status_after === 'ambiguous').length,
    ambiguity_preserved_row_count:
      recordRows.filter((row) => row.locator_status_before === 'ambiguous' && row.locator_status_after === 'ambiguous').length,
    multi_page_locator_row_count:
      recordRows.filter((row) => ['page_backfilled', 'page_located'].includes(row.locator_status_after)
        && asArray(row.locator_candidates).length > 1).length,
    page_text_index_count: asArray(pageTextIndexes).length,
    page_text_hash_count: asArray(pageTextIndexes).reduce(
      (sum, index) => sum + asArray(index?.page_text_index?.page_text_hashes).length,
      0,
    ),
    same_page_multiple_question_exposure_count: samePageRows.length,
    same_page_warning_missing_count:
      samePageRows.filter((row) => row.page_exposure_risk?.requires_user_warning !== true).length,
    unique_ms_document_page_locator_count: sourceDedupeKeys.size,
    document_only_student_reveal_allowed_count:
      recordRows.filter((row) => row.locator_status_after === 'document_only'
        && (row.student_display_allowed === true
          || row.document_reveal_policy?.full_document_student_reveal_allowed === true)).length,
    generated_screenshot_count: Number(sideEffectReceipt?.generated_screenshot_count ?? 0),
    external_ocr_vlm_model_call_count: Number(sideEffectReceipt?.external_ocr_vlm_model_call_count ?? 0),
  };
}
```

Fixed in 45548296b: validatePageTextIndexes now rejects invalid array types, non-record records, missing page_text_index objects, non-false OCR/model flags, invalid extraction methods, hashes, and page numbering.
Fixed in 45548296b: validateSourceArtifacts now fails closed on invalid arrays/non-record entries, missing roles/files, invalid paths/roles, and malformed JSON upstream files.

Fixed in 45548296b: validateRows now rejects invalid rows arrays, non-record rows, malformed/duplicate row IDs, invalid locator_candidates fields, non-record candidates, unsupported guesses, unsafe document_only reveal, collapsed ambiguity, and missing exposure warnings.

Fixed in 45548296b: added regression coverage for null/non-record harnesses, malformed harness arrays, malformed page text index and row records, missing upstream files, and malformed JSON upstream files.
Fixed in 45548296b: buildHarnessRows now normalizes question rows and page text indexes to record-only arrays before mapping or reading properties.
Fixed in 45548296b: recomputeSummary preserves the raw row/index counts while using record-only rows and candidates for property aggregation.
Fixed in 45548296b: buildDocIndex and buildSourceSpanIndex now normalize with asArray, filter record entries, and only index non-empty string IDs.
